scope: B point/cursor driver over the C0 Row read boundary through private source/view traits. Runtime cases use a test-only literal source (independent RowLeaf/XRW1 cells, logical Status/Missing-before answers, literal target values) and a literal view/credit counter. No RowReadOperation, Plan4Target, pin, snapshot, CallerCredit, RowCopyObservation, MissingRowEvidence, ACK or READY is created; the live adapter is compile-checked only because the C0 bodies return Unsupported.

compiler.pass: exit 0 and 0 warnings; also the only compile evidence for driver/live.rs against the actual C0 types

runtime.rule: each selector once; on failure keep the log, fix, rerun only failing/affected selectors and record both runs

runtime_tests.oracle: point Found after copy/release/finish (committed q5, committed exactly at q12), absent keys 1/15/35/41/MAX as checked Missing with page release; exact output bytes and call order

transaction stamp needs Status (committed q8/q10, own Active visible; committed q11, foreign Active, own Aborted invisible); invisible -> Missing only with Missing-before; failed Missing-before is an error; committed-after-q without Undo is MissingUndo with no Missing-before call
FlushRequired from page/Status/Missing-before returns the same target after candidate release and finish; cursor keeps only fully judged invisible rows examined, then retries the same visible row

required-1 OutputTooSmall without copy and exact length succeeds; cancel before call and before copy; failed release after copy not published; CallerMustResolve cleanup replaces an ordinary error and an earlier CallerMustResolve survives a failed cleanup
cursor skips invisible 10 with Missing-before, returns 20/30/40 in order with separate examined/returned keys, End after page release, End again without a page
reseek by full RowId on a shifted leaf with new lower rows, on a leaf without the last examined key, and a bounded [20,40) range ending before 40

cursor OutputTooSmall/cancel (after invisible judgement and before copy)/failed release/failed finish keep last_examined at the invisible row and never skip or return the visible row; retry returns it
revision change -> CursorInvalidated before page, End and cancellation; reopened cursor reads to End; ended statement refused before revision/End/page; keys unchanged
range checked before credit; Capacity before any charge; close returns only its own literal credit; Drop returns the other through the credit's Drop; new cursor takes a new credit; view untouched

not_run.reason: unchanged pure helpers; read.rs diff is the module doc and the driver registration only
C0 RowReadOperation factory/phases return Unchanged Unsupported until C2 supplies the actual source
compile-fail probe (RowCursor::open on a RowStatementView, then finish_statement -> expected E0505) is described for the integrator, not built here
